literal_replacements.before: 1.1 **Per-position polynomial projectors and integer spectra.** The finite-dimensional algebra has a faithful regular representation.
literal_replacements.after: 1.1 **Per-position polynomial projectors and integer spectra.** At rank zero, $H_0(m)=\mathbb C$ has no polynomial generators, the sole empty-word projector and content projector are $1$, and the sector is the single ground-field block with its usual vector duality. Thus all rank-zero assertions follow directly; the spectral argument below concerns $d\ge1$. The finite-dimensional algebra has a faithful regular representation.
